statement: Release 11.9 does not alter the equations in maize_mechanistic_twin.py. It changes the Persistent Twin orchestration so the disclosed mechanistic maize physiology becomes the preferred flowering engine for linked maize synchrony trials, with explicit parent-parameter provenance, local calibration support, model disagreement and uncertainty semantics.

mechanistic_source.status: Independent implementation of disclosed concepts already present in AGROLATTICE; not an exact reproduction of proprietary data or original C++ Bayesian sampler.

new_methods_or_semantics.persistent_mechanistic_integration: Parent-specific mechanistic anthesis/silking thermal targets drive maize Twin timing when trial, sowing dates and daily weather are available.
new_methods_or_semantics.parent_provenance: tln/coblf/ebR1 values are resolved from the parent registry when available, otherwise publication priors are explicitly labelled as priors.
new_methods_or_semantics.calibration_assistant: Prior-regularised local physiology calibration uses linked flowering-event and collared-leaf observations and requires explicit save confirmation.
new_methods_or_semantics.model_disagreement: Difference between mechanistic flowering timing and the pre-existing target-GDD pathway is surfaced rather than silently averaged.
new_methods_or_semantics.time_travel_leakage_guard: Mechanistic event detection at historical as-of dates uses weather only through the selected date.
new_methods_or_semantics.uncertainty_semantics: Data completeness, parameter provenance, event-date interval when computable, and model disagreement are separated.
new_methods_or_semantics.mechanistic_sowing_scenarios: Male sowing offsets are compared with the existing uncertainty-aware mechanistic synchrony optimiser; this optimises timing, not pollen quantity.
new_methods_or_semantics.decision_evidence_link: Twin measurement/recommendation outputs can be persisted into the universal Recommendation → Action → Outcome ledger.
